traps.label: killable
traps.note: Equal keys are moved past each other, reversing ties; witness sortBy([{k:1,id:'a'},{k:1,id:'b'}], x => x.k) gives b before a. The hand suite never sorts ties.

traps.label: equivalent
traps.note: i starts at 0, grows by 1 and keys.length is a fixed non-negative integer, so < and !== stop at the same step.

traps.label: contract-silent
traps.note: Only the error class changes; the CONTRACT says an error is thrown without naming its class.

traps.label: killable
traps.note: Disposable canary: isSortedBy is never true; the hand suite asserts isSortedBy([1, 2, 2, 3]) is true.
